The '''hibrek tree''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] found on the planet [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]]. [[Forest/Legends|Forests]] of hibrek trees covered large swaths of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="NoP" />
